mandatoryAnswer: Qelly is approximately 78-84% complete overall. Prompt 2B is complete within its authorized scope. Prompt 2C code and release artifacts are approximately 84-90% complete, but globally verified production deployment remains 0% because the external hosting environment has not authorized the release branch. The largest truthful increase is normal hosting authorization, followed by exact-head internet verification, then Supabase migration/auth/RLS/sync activation, then official LinkedIn publication.
